headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock May Look Fully Priced After Its 79% Run
summary: Albemarle stock has delivered a strong 79.4% return over the past year, yet its low valuation score and an overvalued read on market multiples suggest the current price may not offer obvious value. The 79.4% 1 year return highlights how quickly sentiment around Albemarle has swung back in favour of the stock, which can leave less room for error if expectations cool.
